summary: Two overlapping requests could both consume one recovery or refresh token under read committed.

regression.name: refuses a consume that overlaps an uncommitted one

summary: A token presented for another purpose was spent before the purpose was checked.

regression.name: refuses a token of another kind without spending it
POST /auth/reset-password refuses a refresh credential and leaves it usable

summary: A password reset left the refresh credentials opened with the old password valid.

regression.name: POST /auth/reset-password ends the refresh sessions opened before it

summary: An unknown, expired or used reset token answered 500 instead of a client error.

regression.name: POST /auth/reset-password refuses a refresh credential and leaves it usable

summary: The Level 1 compose published API, events, web, web-ssr, object storage and clamd on every host interface.

regression.name: ships a compose file that publishes only the gateway on every interface

summary: The API believed X-Forwarded-For from any peer, so a direct client could choose the address its rate limits key on.

regression.name: ignores a forwarded address sent by a public client

summary: The events role trusted no proxy, so every viewer behind the gateway shared the proxy's connection bucket.

regression.name: believes the forwarded address from a private-network proxy

summary: The release downloaded and ran an unpinned Smithery CLI with the registry key in scope.

regression.name: refuses an unpinned download-and-run in a publishing workflow

summary: A manual CLI release from any commit with the same version could upload assets to that release.

regression.name: a manual dispatch from another commit with the same version is refused

summary: Workflow actions were pinned by movable tags rather than commit SHAs.

regression.name: refuses an action pinned by tag

summary: Login answered an unknown email without a hash verification, so its response time revealed which accounts exist.

regression.name: spends a real verification on an unknown account
POST /auth/login answers an unknown email exactly like a wrong password

summary: Password fields had no maximum length, so one request could make the server hash an input as large as the body limit.

regression.name: POST /auth/login refuses a password longer than the limit before hashing it

summary: A module alias from the install request reached a checkout path and git arguments unvalidated: ../ left the checkout and a leading - was read as a git option.

regression.name: refuses %j before running git or touching a path
refuses the alias %j with 400 before fetching anything

summary: The upstream repository and base branch of a module submission reached gh and git arguments unvalidated.

regression.name: refuses %s on %s before running anything

summary: CSV export neutralized =, +, - and @ but not a leading tab or carriage return.

regression.name: prefixes a value starting with a formula-lead character: %s

summary: No shipped edge configuration sent Strict-Transport-Security, so a browser could be downgraded to HTTP on a later visit.

regression.name: every site of the edge Caddyfile sends HSTS

summary: An uploaded file's name went into its object-storage key unchanged; with filesystem storage, ../ segments in a photo, emblem or participant evidence name reached another organization's objects inside the storage root.

regression.name: keeps a traversal filename inside the person and serves the decoded type, not the declared one
stores participant evidence under its organization whatever the filename says

summary: An image was stored and served with the Content-Type its uploader declared, so a valid image declared as text/html was served as HTML.

regression.name: keeps a traversal filename inside the person and serves the decoded type, not the declared one
refuses evidence whose media type carries anything but type/subtype

summary: A module manifest's asset path could name ../ segments, so installing a crafted module read a file outside its package and stored it as a public module asset.

regression.name: refuses %s, which leaves the assets directory
keeps the manifest schema from naming a parent directory
